title: Test the baseline include_notes refusals in task-sync folder import and export
outcome: Test the baseline include_notes refusals in task-sync folder import and export
acceptance: Storage tests show that after a planning-only baseline, a folder export with include_notes true refuses with DivergentPlanning, and a folder import with a notes profile and tree refuses with DivergentPlanning
A positive storage test shows that after a baseline, an export under a different origin_machine alias succeeds with an unchanged export_basis for planning-only data
An --empty-basis import either records origin_machine None in the baseline profile, or the docs state that the baseline's alias is not authoritative
